summary: Frontend testing completed for RACCOON APP - all 7 requested features verified successfully. Guest login flow, Dashboard games section, Match page searching state, Raccoon Feud game page, Truth or Dare game page, Premium page, and Profile page all working correctly.

issues: Logout redirects to /login instead of landing page (/) - minor UX inconsistency but functional

context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend pages tested and working. Guest login creates session with random username (e.g., Guest8779). Socket.IO connection works for real-time matching. Social login buttons (Google, Apple, Phone) are MOCKED UI placeholders as documented.

guest_login_flow.details: Click 'Try as Guest' -> Guest page with gender selection -> Click 'Start Matching Now' -> Redirects to Dashboard with welcome toast

dashboard_page.details: Shows welcome message, Start Matching button, Games section with Raccoon Feud (blue/gold theme) and Truth or Dare (purple/pink theme) cards

match_page_searching.details: Shows 'Finding a Match...' text, rotating raccoon facts, 5 raccoon emojis with wave animation, purple glow background

raccoon_feud_game.details: Blue/gold theme, trophy icon, 'Ready to Play?' text, gold 'Start Game' button with lightning icon

truth_or_dare_game.details: Purple/pink theme, sparkles icon, 'Ready for Truth or Dare?' text, pink 'Start Game' button

premium_page.details: 4 feature categories (Games, Filters, Matching Control, Chat Control), 3 pricing tiers (Weekly $4, Monthly $12 with BEST VALUE badge, 3 Months $28)

profile_page.details: User avatar with initial, username with Guest badge, 4 stats (Sessions, Time Spent, Games Played, Games Won), Account Details section, Logout button
